meta.title: Workspace archiver
meta.description: Adds “Archive and hide this workspace” to a workspace row's context menu (right-click or the … button) in the sidebar. The Host archives every session of that workspace, keeps a hidden record of its path, title, order, and session ids, then removes the workspace registration so the row disappears. Any workspace menu also lists archived workspaces under “Restore archived workspace”, and the /workspace-archiver command restores when every row is hidden. Restore recreates the workspace, reattaches the stored sessions, and unarchives them. If any session cannot be archived (running work or missing permission), the workspace is left in place and the notice reports the blocked count.
